The petitioner is the owner of 3 cents of land and a building in Nerimangalam Village.
A portion of the said property and the building is proposed to be acquired in connection with the construction of NH-85.

According to the petitioner, the new approach road is proposed to be constructed at an elevated height of 5 meters above his property and if that be so, he will literally not be in a position to use the remaining property and the building after demolition as proposed.

Hence, he submitted Ext.P4 representation to the 2nd respondent as well as Ext.P5 representation to the 1 st respondent,
A.D. Thankachan vs Project Director on 9 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128095806/
2 requesting to acquire the entire property and building belonging to him.

sentences.text: The petitioner has approached this Court to give a direction to dispose of Exts. P4 and P5 representations in accordance with law.
2. I have heard Sri.Peeyus A.Kottam, the learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri.Rajeev Jyothish George, the learned Government Pleader.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that if only WP(C) NO. 26970 OF 2024 2024:KER:75044 a portion of land and building of the petitioner is acquired as proposed, the petitioner cannot use the remaining property and the building.
It is in these circumstances, the petitioner submitted Exts.P4 and P5 representations with a request to acquire the entire 3 cents of land and the building.

4. Section 94 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the Act, 2013') provides an option to the owner of the land to request the authorities to acquire the entire building if only a part of the building is being acquired.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, the question whether Section 94 the Act, 2013 would apply to the acquisition under the National Highways Act is pending before the Division Bench for consideration.

At any rate, as per Section 28 (3) of the Act, 2013, in determining the amount of compensation to be awarded for land acquired under the Act, the Collector is bound to take into consideration, the damage if any sustained by the person interested, at the time of the Collector's taking possession of the land, by reason of severing such land from his other land.

5. The learned Government Pleader submits that the WP(C) NO. 26970 OF 2024 2024:KER:75044 competent authority to consider Ext.P4 representation is respondent No.4.
6.

Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Government Pleader, this writ petition is disposed of as follows:
1. The petitioner shall give a copy of Ext.P4 representation to the 4th respondent within two weeks.
2. The 4th respondent shall dispose of the same, in accordance with law, after hearing the petitioner, within a period of one month thereafter.

3. In case, the 4th respondent does not consider the request of the petitioner to acquire the entire 3 cents of land, necessarily the 4th respondent shall take into account Section 28(3) of the Act, 2013 while determining the compensation.

Sd/-
